Almost every correct answer in this exam has the same shape. It:

  1. reads the requirement literally;
  2. measures before changing anything;
  3. uses the simplest architecture that meets the numbers;
  4. enforces risk with controls rather than instructions;
  5. leaves a feedback loop behind.

Distractors break one of those five rules. Figure 22.1 is the order in which to test an option.
